budget.rationale: The clean-source matched city pilot at fa39f8a retained all84 audited worlds across12 groups; all84 completed, no infrastructure/audit failures. Full measured wall time was 4517.119780s, yielding 21079.892307s serial extrapolation for56 cases/392 worlds. The30000s whole-study split start allowance provides42.3% headroom for verification and machine variability; it is not a hard timeout or performance promise. Train24 and validation12 will use two independent single-worker collector processes with separate outputs/TraCI sockets and shared read-only frozen inputs; test20 is serial and starts only after one frozen selection/release. Pilot-based critical-path expectation is about4.6h plus verification overhead, leaving time inside the owner's7-10h overall window for final product QA/publication. The inventory includes an entirely held-out heavy regime and one actual ordered route family; all RNG seeds are unique, untouched22001-22056, excluding all pilot seeds and declared exploration7/8. One predeclared sparse test case retains six bounded private5s traces for cached-export acceptance; no public coarse demo is promised.
